intro: Costs and timing are starting estimates for Hartford, CT. The average last spring frost is around early May, so warm-season crops go outside mid-to-late May.

crops.name: Tomatoes
crops.startingCost: $15-30 for a 5-gal bucket, soil, stake, and one seedling
crops.space: Container (5 gal+) or raised bed; full sun, 6-8 hrs
crops.watering: Deep watering 2-3x a week; daily in heat for containers
crops.troubleSigns: Yellow lower leaves with brown spots (early blight); cracked fruit from uneven watering; dark sunken fruit bottoms (blossom end rot)

crops.name: Lettuce
crops.startingCost: $5-15 for seeds and a shallow container
crops.whenToPlant: Seeds April-May, again mid-August for fall
crops.troubleSigns: Bolting (tall stalk, bitter leaves) in summer heat; slugs leave holes and slime trails

crops.name: Peppers
crops.space: Container (3-5 gal) or bed; full sun
crops.whenToPlant: Seedlings outside late May once nights stay above 50F
crops.watering: Steady moisture; don't let containers dry out
crops.troubleSigns: Flowers dropping in extreme heat; soft sunken spots on fruit

crops.name: Basil
crops.startingCost: $5-10 for seeds or one starter plant
crops.space: Small pot on a sunny windowsill or porch
crops.whenToPlant: Outside late May; indoors any time with a sunny window
crops.troubleSigns: Black leaves after cold nights; gray fuzz under leaves (downy mildew)

crops.name: Bush beans
crops.space: Wide container or bed; full sun, no trellis needed
crops.troubleSigns: Poor sprouting in cold soil; tiny holes from beetles

crops.name: Strawberries
crops.startingCost: $15-30 for plants and a hanging basket or bed
crops.space: Hanging basket, strawberry pot, or bed; full sun
crops.whenToPlant: Plants in April-May; day-neutral types fruit the first summer
crops.troubleSigns: Gray mold on berries in wet weather; birds and squirrels

hydroponics.title: Hydroponics
hydroponics.description: Grow greens year-round with water and nutrients instead of soil. A simple Kratky jar or tote system (no pump) can start around $20-40; a small PVC channel system with a pump, $100-250.
hydroponics.localExample: Local example: Levo International runs hydroponic farms in Hartford on Homestead Ave, Enfield St, and Garden St.
